notes.title: PATCH NOTES #1
notes.content:
Good news everyone ːsteamhappyː

1. Added: a button 'New' - now you can either continue your old game or start a new one:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32750708/ec52c3898ca1bf844517966c66bb163457086683.jpg[/img]

2. Added: by the campfire, you can now see the fighter's name and experience:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32750708/ab00ca5e2b52e737ad8e57031ff978a8ed9fe46d.jpg[/img]

3. Added: now you can dismiss a fighter from your party. To do it, click on the fighter sitting by the campfire and click on 'Dismiss' button.

4. Added: now the game supports the "Run in Background" mode - you can minimize the game and the units will fight automatically.

5. Fixed: now the menu button leads to the menu and doesn't close the game.

6. Fixed: now when you leave the tavern, the panel 'Change Name' will close.
